name: Rosemary Bhandari
life: “I still remember a founder coming back with a payment in small change.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Rosemary by a small Saturday habit. Rosemary notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I was their first lender. The woman I underestimated has been paying every installment.
appearance: Rosemary has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Look for short white hair and darker eyebrows. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a boxy denim jacket with a braided bracelet with a single wooden bead. In conversation Rosemary squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Rosemary keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Rosemary wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To credit the founder who made the payments.
family: Sofia Yates is Rosemary’s younger cousin. Rosemary can always ask for five minutes alone. Sofia asks before bringing somebody along. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The empty drum stool*, Sofia says, “I was scared my students would laugh at my playing.”
connections: Marlowe Nord. The early lender and the employee shareholder remember exactly when wages stopped arriving.

reactions.situation: The divorcing founders ask staff to pick a side
reactions.response: Rosemary asks when the next wages will arrive before giving either founder a public endorsement.

reactions.situation: A traveler asks for the last seat at the bus stop
reactions.response: Rosemary asks the person already using it whether they can comfortably stand, rather than presuming who needs it most.

reactions.situation: When somebody asks who said it first
reactions.response: Rosemary offers to introduce them to the person willing to put a name to it.
